pairs.subject: wizard-flows
pairs.evidence: app/apply/[id]/ConversationalApply.tsx:344 Answering the final question submits the application immediately, without a whole-draft review and explicit confirmation.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/apply.ts:112 The pre-commit interview uses a fixed, localized script with declared conditional lanes, rather than generatively chosen questions.

app/_lib/apply-intake.ts:413 Profile assembly includes student evidence by presence, without checking archetype relevance; branch exclusion is enforced during navigation rather than in the commit assembler.
app/apply/[id]/ConversationalApply.tsx:344 The last answer triggers submission directly; the candidate never reviews the assembled commitment or explicitly confirms it.

app/apply/[id]/ConversationalApply.tsx:524 The flow presents one current screening question at a time, following the technique's measurement exception; knockout controls also avoid recommending the passing answer.

app/apply/[id]/ConversationalApply.tsx:484 The live log announces transcript messages, while the changing step position is rendered outside it; transitions do not announce both position and question as required.
app/apply/[id]/use-apply-draft.ts:96 A readable draft restores automatically before any resume-or-discard choice; incompatible and corrupt drafts also become quiet fresh starts.
app/apply/[id]/ConversationalApply.tsx:326 The transition guards busy and already-answered state, but does not enforce a shared validity predicate; text validation lives separately in submitText.

pairs.subject: wizard-flows
pairs.evidence: app/features/shell/setup/OnboardingExperience.tsx:321 An exception during finish closes the wizard, clears its draft and stamps completion, potentially losing recovery state after earlier writes applied.

techniques.evidence: app/features/shell/setup/SetupWizardStepPane.tsx:79 The companion step renders fixed consent choices from a status probe; it does not run a generative interview.

app/features/shell/setup/setupOnboardingFinish.ts:46 Finish derives eligible writers from the same relevance filtering as navigation, excluding retained company, invite, pipeline and companion answers on the seeker branch.

app/features/shell/setup/OnboardingExperience.tsx:321 Returned partial failures receive receipts and selective retries, but a thrown write instead reaches settle(), discarding the draft without accounting for applied and unattempted parts.

app/features/shell/setup/OnboardingExperience.tsx:114 After the intent fork, independent company, team, pipeline and companion choices remain separate sequential screens; eligible questions are not batched from an authored dependency frontier.
app/features/shell/setup/SetupOnboardingWizard.tsx:105 Completion checkmarks depend only on position, ignoring visited status and current validity, and disappear when navigating backward.
app/features/shell/setup/useSetupDraft.ts:75 The stored draft restores automatically without an offer; parsing also treats corrupt storage as a missing draft rather than reporting recovery failure.
app/features/shell/setup/OnboardingExperience.tsx:115 The next() transition advances without checking stepSatisfied; validity is enforced by its UI callers instead of inside the transition.
